mapper.insert: INSERT INTO login_attempts (id, kind, login_key_hash, client_ip, result, attempted_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{kind}, #{loginKeyHash}, #{clientIp}, #{result}, #{attemptedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(recent.id) FROM (SELECT a.id FROM login_attempts a WHERE a.kind = 'LOGIN' AND a.result = 'FAILURE' AND a.client_ip = #{clientIp} AND a.attempted_at > #{since} ORDER BY a.attempted_at DESC, a.id DESC LIMIT #{cap}) recent

SELECT COUNT(recent.id) FROM (SELECT a.id FROM login_attempts a WHERE a.kind = 'SIGNUP' AND a.client_ip = #{clientIp} AND a.attempted_at > #{since} ORDER BY a.attempted_at DESC, a.id DESC LIMIT #{cap}) recent
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM login_attempts WHERE id IN (SELECT old.id FROM login_attempts old WHERE old.attempted_at < #{before} ORDER BY old.attempted_at ASC, old.id ASC LIMIT #{limit} FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED)
